title: The Art Den

services.name: Class
services.desc: Learning how to create digital art is an excellent way to expand your artistic abilities! This is an opportunity to take your drawing skills to the next level! This course will cover sketching, character drawing, color usage, as well as shading and lighting techniques. No previous experience is required but having a basic knowledge of your preferred drawing software is highly recommended. Please bring an electronic device capable of running a digital art software, and have one downloaded before class! I recommend bringing an iPad Pro with an Apple Pencil and using an app called “Procreate,” however there are alternatives for creating digital art! See the list below for some suggestions!

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: It’s our 7th year of summer camp and we are so excited! Each camp week will feature 7 projects or lessons, including but not limited to: tie-dye, wheel thrown and sculpted clay projects, acrylic painting, paint your own pottery, drawing lessons, and fused glass. This year we are excited to introduce themes to our Summer Camp. This will give our campers the chance to sign-up for themes that they are interested in and to see some of the projects ahead of time. Please note that creativity will always reign supreme at the den, and any camper who isn’t in love with the theme but can only come that week will have the freedom to choose their own subject for projects.
